scoring_time.timestamp_definition: T0=leads.created_at; T1=first inquiries.inquiry_at; T2=second and later inquiries.inquiry_at while no scheduled_visit has already occurred

population.eligibility: Scoring snapshots with a complete 30-day future observation window; T1/T2 are generated only before a known scheduled visit has occurred.
exclusions: Dynamic snapshots after an already observed scheduled visit.
Current/future broker-response information from model inputs.

question: How stable are target prevalence, feature distributions and a frozen specialist Random Forest across future lead cohorts?
hypothesis: The Spot2 synthetic process is temporally non-stationary: target prevalence and/or important feature distributions will shift materially across rolling future cohorts.
primary_change: replace the single 70/15/15 evaluation with expanding rolling temporal folds while holding target, point-in-time features and model family fixed
secondary_changes: report feature PSI early vs late
report AP normalized by prevalence to separate discrimination from prevalence drift

validation.split_description: For each fold, train on all earlier lead cohorts, calibrate on the next month, and test on the following two months; test windows are disjoint and all snapshots for a lead remain together.

items.evidence: Inherited unchanged from E005; lead_score_internal, current broker outcome/timing and mutable current-state Spot aggregates remain blocked.
